steps.name: siwe-message-contract
steps.summary: Auth challenge/login now uses a SIWE v1 message contract with alphanumeric nonce normalization, persisted domain/uri/chainId challenge binding, full SIWE context mismatch rejection, API/sequence docs updates, and regression coverage in scripts/test_siwe_message_contract.py.

steps.name: wallet-signature-verifier-port
steps.summary: Wallet signature verification now uses an account-type neutral verify_signature(wallet, message, signature, chain_id) result port, with EOA recover-address compatibility inside the adapter and live chain-id wiring for future ERC-1271 support.

steps.name: erc1271-smart-wallet-verification
steps.summary: Auth signature verification now supports deployed ERC-1271 smart wallets via get_code + isValidSignature(bytes32,bytes), with auth RPC chain/timeout runtime config and regression coverage.

steps.name: auth-api-runtime-docs
steps.summary: Auth API/runtime docs and Postman fixtures now expose SIWE v1 fields, EOA/deployed ERC-1271 verification metadata, and preserve cookie-first CSRF/CORS/refresh rotation contracts.
